content: We assume that the context of the word INLINEFORM0 will be the original context ( INLINEFORM1 ) and the equation units ( INLINEFORM2 ) of any equations that are in the word-equation context window. In addition for each equation unit we define its unit context INLINEFORM3 to be the set of surrounding equation units in a small window INLINEFORM4 around it: DISPLAYFORM0
